content: खिलः, -लम् [खिल्-क] .²1 A piece of waste or uncultivated land, desert or bare soil; a desert, waste; खिले गा विष्ठिता इव <ls>Av. 7. 115. 4</ls>. .²2 A gap, vacant place. .²3 An additional hymn appended to the regular collection; <ls>Ms. 3. 232</ls>. .²4 A supplement in general. .²5 A compendium, compilation. .²6 Vacuity. .²7 Remainder; अलं दग्धैर्द्रुमैर्दीनैः खिलानां शिवमस्तु नः <ls>Bhāg. 6. 4. 15</ls>. .{@-लः@} <ab>N.</ab> of Brahmā and of Viṣṇu. [खिल is often used in combination with भू and कृ; (1) खिलीभू .³({%a%}) to become impassable, to be blocked up, be left unfrequented; खिलीभूते विमानानां तदापातभयात्पथि <ls>Ku. 2. 45</ls>. .³({%b%}) to be impossible, be rendered impracticable or stopped; प्रजागरात्खिलीभूतस्तस्याः स्वप्नसमागमः <ls>Ś. 6. 22</ls>. (2) खिलीकृ means .³({%a%}) to obstruct, impede, make impassable, block up; तौ सुकेतसुतया खिलीकृते <ls>R. 11. 14</ls>, <ls n="R. 11.">87</ls>. .³({%b%}) to lay waste, devastate, put down or vanquish completely; विपक्षमखिलीकृत्य प्रतिष्ठा खलु दुर्लभा <ls>Śi. 2. 34.</ls>]
